description: Vital Signs: Transit Ridership per Capita by Operator - Bay Area (2022) is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. VITAL SIGNS INDICATOR Transit Ridership (T11) FULL MEASURE NAME Daily transit boardings LAST UPDATED February 2023 DESCRIPTION Transit ridership refers to the number of passenger boardings on public transportation, which includes buses, rail systems and ferries. The dataset includes metropolitan area, regional, mode and operator tables for total typical weekday boardings. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are vital signs 2.0, t11t12, vital signs. The table has 10 columns. The portal shows 2023-02-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
